title: SkelOT artifact: Reusing AOT Compilation Across EVM Contract Families (EuroSys 2027)
description: Artifact for the EuroSys 2027 paper "SkelOT: Reusing AOT Compilation Across EVM Contract Families": the SkelOT prototype (a fork of revmc), the experiment drivers and analysis scripts behind every number in the paper, precomputed results, a Dockerfile, and a README that maps each component to the paper. The block-window corpora it consumes are archived separately on Zenodo and linked from the README.
